description: Head of Engineering at a 600-person contact-center software company replacing a vendor, launching this month.

transcript.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant running a short qualification chat for the Voice AI Readiness Assessment. It takes about three minutes. What are you looking to build or improve with voice AI?
We run a contact center platform and we need to ship a production voice agent that handles inbound support calls for our customers. It has to go to real callers.
Got it, a production support agent for inbound calls. Roughly how many people are at your company?
Around 600, thanks. When are you hoping to have something live?
Honestly, in the next three or four weeks. We have a customer launch at the end of the month.
So within the month. What are you using today: building in-house, another provider, or starting from zero?
We're on another provider right now and we're replacing them because latency is killing us.
Replacing a current vendor, understood. And what is your role on the team?
I'm the VP of Engineering, I own the budget for this.
